summary: Keep dialogue useful to the current stage of protocol development by deferring questions that depend on a hypothetical application.

evidence.lesson: On this dialogue PR, pemulis asked to save use-case-specific questions for when those use cases are being built and to focus on the protocol for now.

evaluation: Retain if subsequent questions surface protocol decisions without founders having to redirect speculative application design. Revisit when a concrete use case enters development or founders request a different focus.

changes.after_guidance: For now, favor questions about the protocol itself. If a question depends on how a particular application should work, save it for when that use case is being built. A concrete example is welcome when it clarifies a broader protocol question.
